checklistRows.question_or_check: Is this a current inbound person asking for help now, or an old WhatsApp/TalkTo lead?
checklistRows.allowed_response: Current inbound may continue only after explicit permission to check lawyer/supplier fit. Old leads require re-permission first.
checklistRows.private_note_no_pii: Record source channel, date bucket and permission status only; do not paste full chat content into a shared packet.
checklistRows.route_or_owner_decision: Use private intake only; no public copy or CRM import is approved by this checklist.
checklistRows.blocker: Missing explicit permission or owner-approved re-permission path.
checklistRows.forbidden_action: Do not contact old leads, lawyers or suppliers from this row.

checklistRows.question_or_check: Is the problem limited to rental, deposit, post-return charge, cancellation, refund, damage charge or rental terms?
checklistRows.allowed_response: Yes means candidate for the narrow private RV rental/deposit/charge pilot. No means park or route to separate review.
checklistRows.private_note_no_pii: Use category labels only; avoid names, phones, emails, vehicle plates or full booking numbers.
checklistRows.route_or_owner_decision: Preferred private path maps to consumer/rental surfaces, not a standalone RV route.
checklistRows.blocker: Insurance, accident, injury or traffic facts appear in the same story.
checklistRows.forbidden_action: Do not merge accident, insurance or traffic matters into this first pilot.
checklistRows.source_context: SERP packet recommends rental/deposit/charge only as first pilot.

checklistRows.question_or_check: Which neutral evidence exists: agreement, booking confirmation, invoice, photos, supplier messages, chargeback/refund attempt, dates and amount?
checklistRows.allowed_response: Collect a short no-PII evidence checklist before legal or partner preview.
checklistRows.private_note_no_pii: Use amount range, country, supplier type and document yes/no flags; store sensitive files only in approved private systems.
checklistRows.route_or_owner_decision: Evidence checklist can prepare a later lawyer review but does not create legal advice.
checklistRows.blocker: No agreement, no invoice and no charge detail yet.
checklistRows.forbidden_action: Do not forward private evidence to a lawyer/supplier until permission and owner release exist.
checklistRows.source_context: Supplier terms rows in SERP packet support evidence-first triage.

checklistRows.question_or_check: Is the disputed amount and urgency suitable for paid help, small-claims guidance, or owner hold?
checklistRows.allowed_response: Classify as low, medium or high value; recommend no guarantee and no automatic paid handoff.
checklistRows.private_note_no_pii: Use currency and amount band, not card digits or payment screenshots in shared reports.
checklistRows.route_or_owner_decision: Owner decides whether this is worth a controlled private pilot before any public page work.
checklistRows.blocker: Value too low, facts unclear, or urgency needs a licensed lawyer immediately.
checklistRows.forbidden_action: Do not promise recovery, price, timeline or lawyer acceptance.

checklistRows.question_or_check: Has a licensed/legal reviewer approved the exact positioning before demand-letter, claim or negotiation wording?
checklistRows.allowed_response: Proceed only to owner-review/private legal-review queue; public advice remains blocked.
checklistRows.private_note_no_pii: Keep the summary factual and neutral until legal review decides the path.
checklistRows.route_or_owner_decision: Legal review required before demand-letter or claim-position language.
checklistRows.forbidden_action: Do not generate public advice, coverage advice, demand letter text or claim text from this checklist.
checklistRows.source_context: Public RV copy remains blocked by GSC and legal review.

checklistRows.question_or_check: Can a lawyer or supplier receive only anonymized facts before client identity is released?
checklistRows.allowed_response: Yes, only after permission, partner terms status and owner release are recorded.
checklistRows.private_note_no_pii: Preview should use issue type, country, amount band, document flags and urgency only.
checklistRows.route_or_owner_decision: Use no-PII preview first; release identity only after all gates pass.
checklistRows.blocker: No accepted partner terms or no explicit client permission.
checklistRows.forbidden_action: Do not send name, phone, email, chat transcript, booking number or files to a partner.
checklistRows.source_context: WhatsApp/TalkTo runbook requires no-PII partner preview and terms.

checklistRows.question_or_check: Are accepted terms, billing contact, invoice reference and payment proof available?
checklistRows.allowed_response: Only count money after invoice/reference or private payment proof exists.
checklistRows.private_note_no_pii: Store proof reference, not sensitive payment details, in the shared checklist.
checklistRows.route_or_owner_decision: Revenue is not counted until proof exists in the approved admin flow.
checklistRows.blocker: No invoice reference, no payment evidence or no accepted partner terms.
checklistRows.forbidden_action: Do not mark paid, claim revenue or route as paid lead without proof.
checklistRows.source_context: CRM runbook billing proof gate remains required.

checklistRows.question_or_check: For past WhatsApp/TalkTo leads, is there a fresh permission message or owner-approved re-permission workflow?
checklistRows.allowed_response: If yes, continue as current inbound only after the new permission. If no, keep parked.
checklistRows.private_note_no_pii: Use batch label and re-permission status only.
checklistRows.route_or_owner_decision: Legacy rows default to hold; no retroactive matching.
checklistRows.forbidden_action: Do not bulk message, import, match, call or email old leads from this checklist.
checklistRows.source_context: Owner explicitly flagged permission risk for past untreated clients.

checklistRows.question_or_check: Does this intake evidence justify a public page or public section today?
checklistRows.allowed_response: No. Keep private-only until GSC export, owner decision and legal review approve exact text.
checklistRows.private_note_no_pii: Use private learnings only to decide whether a future public-review packet is worth drafting.
checklistRows.route_or_owner_decision: No standalone RV route; possible future tiny section on consumer/rental pages only after approval.
checklistRows.blocker: GSC export template is not filled.
checklistRows.forbidden_action: Do not change title, H1, meta, URL, internal links, canonical, sitemap or CMS content.
checklistRows.source_context: GSC evidence request status: export not filled.

checklistRows.question_or_check: Does the story include insurance coverage, accident, injury, traffic fine, criminal/regulatory or urgent limitation-period facts?
checklistRows.allowed_response: Escalate out of the Low Hype RV rental pilot and park for specialist review.
checklistRows.private_note_no_pii: Tag the issue family only and keep sensitive facts in approved private systems.
checklistRows.route_or_owner_decision: Separate review required; not part of first rental/deposit/charge pilot.
checklistRows.forbidden_action: Do not treat specialist cases as consumer/rental managed-service leads without legal review.
checklistRows.source_context: SERP and route packets flag insurance/traffic/accident cannibalization risk.
